These images are public Google MediaPipe example/test fixtures, downloaded only for local model verification using `node scripts/test-assets.mjs`. They are not used by the app or included in its production build.

- `fist.jpg`: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/tasks/testdata/vision/fist.jpg — listed in https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe/blob/master/third_party/external_files.bzl
- `right_hands.jpg`: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/tasks/testdata/vision/right_hands.jpg — Google's open-hand test image, listed in the same manifest.
- `pose.jpg` and `portrait.jpg`: the same Google MediaPipe test-data directory, used to verify real body and face inference.
- `woman_hands.jpg`: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-tasks/hand_landmarker/woman_hands.jpg — Google sample https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe-samples/blob/main/examples/hand_landmarker/python/hand_landmarker.ipynb attributes it to https://unsplash.com/photos/mt2fyrdXxzk
